correctness.rationale: Pinned RESULT.md constructs normalized trace|M|/q^d factorization and an orthogonal spectral sign witness, then diagonalizes the Cartesian Hamming adjacency through tensor eigenspaces. A centered binomial positive-part telescoping identity gives the single-boundary mass at floor(d/q), including integer boundaries. Piecewise derivative proves strict q monotonicity. Poisson and binomial local CLT give the two limits; at integer cusp the two boundary probabilities agree but left/right derivatives differ. Independent exact rational spectral sums agree with formula and strictly grow for 2≤d≤34, 2≤q≤21 (660 pairs).
